_comment: Registered metrics for road-to-token-economy-dispatch Phase 1 (registered BEFORE any reduction lever ships — the budget-ownership discipline of hook-latency-budget.json / preamble-payload-budget.json). Baseline anchor: road-to-cache-economy census 2026-07-30 (median subagent cold start 235.5k tokens written-or-uncached, C-1 cold-start dominance 69.7%). Thresholds are the roadmap's committed numbers; changing one is a PR citing evidence, never a drive-by edit.

dispatch_floor.definition: Median init_tokens per role (worker, reviewer) and the COST-shaped init/work ratio per dispatched leg. init_tokens = billable_input of the leg's FIRST assistant record (raw — comparable to the cache-economy 235.5k baseline); work_tokens = leg total billable_input minus init_tokens. The RATIO is computed on weighted input units (read 0.1x, 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2.0x — _lib/cc_transcript.ts weightedInputUnits), NOT raw billable_input: raw counts every later turn's cache-read re-transmission at full weight, which makes the 'more spent loading than working' threshold unmeetable by construction (measured live 2026-08-10: raw ratio 0.02 on the same legs). billable_input = input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens (never usage.input_tokens alone).
dispatch_floor.source: Primary: transcript ledger via src/scripts/_lib/cc_transcript.ts (per-agentId legs, message.id+requestId dedupe). Secondary: audit-log orchestration lines carrying init_tokens/work_tokens with floor_provenance=measured.
dispatch_floor.role_attribution: HONEST LIMITATION until the role axis (Phase 2) ships: transcripts carry no session role, so all subagent legs report as role=worker; reviewer legs are attributed from audit-line agent_combo where present. The report states which attribution produced each number.

thresholds._projection_mandatory: sustained median init/work ratio > 1.0 for rung-1 workers over a review window makes Phase 3 (worker thin projection) mandatory, not optional
thresholds._success: median ratio < 0.15 after Phase 3 ships is the roadmap's registered success criterion

baseline.source: road-to-cache-economy first-party measurement (14-day window, host CC 2.1.220); re-measure on the post-9.29 tree is Phase 1's first report run

rules_efficiency.definition: rules_used / rules_carried per worker envelope (fields shipped by road-to-lean-agent-init, validated in _lib/orchestration_record.ts). Sustained low quota is simultaneously the Phase 3 cut-line evidence AND the demand-signal datum later/road-to-deferred-rule-retriever gate (2c) asks for — one measurement, two consumers.
rules_efficiency.source: Audit-log orchestration lines (agents/runtime/state/audit/*.jsonl) where both fields are non-null.

thresholds._low_quota: a sustained median quota below 0.2 over the review window is the cut-line evidence Phase 3.1 requires (>= 2 weeks of data) and the retriever gate's demand signal

honest_null_consequence: If the re-measured floor on the post-9.29 tree is materially smaller than the cache-economy baseline (roadmap step 1.4), phases 3-5 of road-to-token-economy-dispatch downgrade to blockers citing the null, and the null is published in docs/benchmark.md. A metric nobody re-runs by review_by is treated as the latency file's fossilization failure: the report command below is the re-verification procedure.
